summary: Moved every rounding rule into meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed), removed the decimal-context line and all other rounding/precision formatting from the other modules, and added tests/test_money.py; existing tests pass and a differential fuzz against the original package showed no output differences. Preserved quirks (not fixed): batch worker threads have always rounded band charges and the per-kWh price half-even (the context was only set on the main thread), now kept via keyword-only method parameters; VAT rounds half-even; a whole-unit payable never shows -0 although a step payable can show -0.00.
